description: Joulescope JS220 precision energy analyzer over USB, through pyjoulescope_driver 2.5.5. Written from the driver's topic list and host parameters; not yet checked against a real JS220.
burden: The JS220 measures current through a shunt in series with the DUT supply between IN and OUT. Each current range adds its own series resistance (burden voltage), and auto-ranging switches it while the DUT runs; a manual range that is too small adds more drop and saturates. A readback confirms the meter's settings, not that the DUT was undisturbed.
signConvention: Positive current flows from the meter's IN to its OUT terminals, into the DUT; voltage is measured at OUT against the meter's ground.
